captions.footer: SIMULATION computed from the published SBML model; not an observation.  Time and concentrations are non-dimensional (model time).  Two abstract cells: this is not tissue, not a fin, and no cell shape is modelled or observed.
captions.header: Two-cell Delta-Notch lateral inhibition - BioModels BIOMD0000001047 (Collier et al. 1996) - SIMULATION

does_not_show: real time or physical concentration units
claims.shows: two-cell Delta-Notch concentrations vs model time and (Notch, Delta) phase portraits for three replay scenarios

evidence_kind: simulated: a rendering of replay output; not an observation of any biological system

poster.frame: last row (model time 60.0), not a separate simulation

render.frames_sha256_note: sha256 of the raw RGBA stream sent to the encoder; depends on the drawing, not the encoder build

time_mapping.interpolation: none: only rows present in the CSV are drawn
time_mapping.note: most of the change happens before model time 30; the second half of the video is the settled state
time_mapping.rule: frame k < motion_frames shows csv row round(k*(rows-1)/(motion_frames-1)); later frames repeat the last row
